title: State of the Trenches, 2026-W45: fees −13.9% week over week
dek: Launchpad fees were $16.8M across 14 non-overlapping venues and creator earnings $9.03M; Anthropic IPO coins led narrative volume.

body.text: The covered launchpad fee subtotal for 2026-W45 (Nov 2, 2026 to Nov 8, 2026, UTC) was $16.8M across 14 non-overlapping venues, −13.9% against 2026-W44 on the same venues. 5 venues that share a fee stream with another venue are reported individually and never added.
Creator earnings — fees paid to coin creators and, depending on the venue's own definition, holders, referrers or traders — were $9.03M across 16 venues that define them, −12.7% week over week.
By share of the subtotal, LaunchLab gained the most (+3.0 points) and Flap.sh lost the most (-2.7 points). A share shift says where fees moved, not why.

Trading in the coins of the tracked narratives totalled $505.72M for the week, counting a coin once when it belongs to more than one narrative (the per-narrative totals add up to $527.32M). This is the volume of identified coins across their indexed pools, not of the whole market.

Anthropic IPO coins carried the most volume among narratives collected during the week: $296.1M (partial: some member-days were not observed). Its week-over-week change is withheld: 2 of 5 members present in both weeks were fully observed in both, below the comparable-basket minimum.

First observed this week: Anakin Skywalker headline coins, Be Like José coins, GTA 6 launch coins, Democrats win Congress coins. A narrative's first week has no meaningful prior week, so no change is reported for it.

Collection paused during the week: Anakin Skywalker headline coins, Democrats win Congress coins, Binance hack coins, Lightberry Lumi coins. Their members stay members; their totals after the pause are partial, not zero.
